_readme: 数据冻结层。每季只往 series 右端追加当季那一期；历史点只读。窗口切片由 window_max 控制：8 = 两年上限（只加不删，满 8 期才裁左端）；null = 不设上限，左端永不裁（图 15-19 必须是 null）。ylim / ytick 也是冻结的，只扩不缩。footnote 用占位符，滚动时自动更新。 T1 也在这里（tbl01_capital_structure）。B 类标题（图 15/16/17/18/20）另存 title_fixed + title_claim，claim 每季按数据重算并跑 titlecheck.verify()。

fig05_pik_share.footnote: * PIK interest + PIK dividends ÷ total investment income, single-quarter basis; year-end point = full year − nine months; each point from that period's filing. {cq} = \${num}mm ÷ \${den}mm = {val}%. Gray series: BDC sector average PIK share of total investment income — quarterly through {thru}; no {cq} sector print yet.

tbl01_capital_structure._note: T1 出成 PNG（tablelib.py）。rows 每行 = {label, pq, cq, qoq, src}；src 必须指到 10-Q 页码 + 算式。绝不许从上一版报告的表格抄数当占位。

tbl03_software_layer.src: 本季 10-Q Schedule of Investments 逐家公允值汇总；公司→分层取 _state/layer_map.json（本季新增 <N> 家已判层）；混合敞口 = Σ 占比×权重。⛔ 禁止取草稿 xlsx 的 Crosscheck sheet，那是去年数据
tbl03_software_layer.note: Layer assignment is by borrower primary business, not GICS. Percentages are computed from the current quarter's Schedule of Investments at fair value. Blended AI-impact score = sum of layer share x impact weight. Source: OTF {cq} 10-Q, Schedule of Investments
